title: HoustonDirectoryArchiveSchema
description: A JSON Schema validating the parsed and structured outputs for the 1870-1901 Houston City and Professional Directories project. It defines validation constraints for the individuals.csv and organizations.csv tables.

individuals.description: A list of structured historical records representing individual residents, lodgers, partners, and workers.

organizations.description: A list of structured historical records representing businesses, civic organizations, religious bodies, and partnerships.

IndividualRow.description: Represents a single parsed line in the individuals CSV corresponding to an individual person.

entry_id.description: Unique identifier generated for this record (e.g., IND_1892_0001).

source_directory.description: The exact title of the physical directory source.

directory_year.description: The starting publication or coverage year of the directory (e.g., 1892).

page_number.description: The directory page number where this entry was transcribed from (string, to account for Roman numerals or suffixes like 92A).

raw_entry_text.description: The literal, unaltered text segment extracted directly from the page image or raw OCR.

surname.description: Normalized surname of the individual in capital letters (e.g., HARMON).

given_names.description: Normalized given names and initials (e.g., FREDERICK A.). Null if unspecified.

prefix_honorific.description: Social or professional prefixes such as Dr., Rev., Capt.

suffix.description: Generational suffixes such as Jr., Sr., III.

civil_status_raw.description: Unaltered status notes extracted from the text, indicating marital/domestic state (e.g., wid J. H., widow of James).

spouse_name.description: Normalized spouse name where domestic links are parsed.

spouse_id.description: Matching entry ID pointing to the spouse's individual record (if also present in the directory).

occupation.description: Unaltered transcription of the individual's listed trade, profession, or role.

demographic_marker_raw.description: The unaltered transcription of demographic, racial, or social symbols used next to the name (e.g., (c), col., *).

employer_name_raw.description: Unaltered transcription of employer, firm, or institutional name.

employer_organization_id.description: Relational pointer to the matching record in organizations.csv.

role_title_raw.description: Specific employment title or capacity within an employer firm (e.g., Treasurer, clerk).

residential_address_raw.description: Literal address associated with residential keys (such as r. or res.).

boarding_address_raw.description: Literal address associated with boarding terms (such as bds).

rooming_address_raw.description: Literal address associated with rooming terms (such as rms).

living_address_raw.description: Unaltered address string used where the residential structure is non-specific or general.

business_address_raw.description: Literal address of the workplace listed on this individual's row (such as Office 3101 Main).

OrganizationRow.description: Represents a single parsed line in the organizations CSV corresponding to a business, firm, or society.

organization_id.description: Unique identifier generated for this organization (e.g., ORG_1892_0001).

source_directory.description: The exact title of the physical directory source.

directory_year.description: The starting publication or coverage year of the directory.

page_number.description: The directory page number where this organization entry was transcribed.

raw_entry_text.description: The literal, unaltered text segment extracted directly from the page image or raw OCR.

organization_name.description: The transcribed and normalized name of the firm or institution (e.g., HOUSTON COLD STORAGE CO.).

business_type_industry.description: Standardized category indices mapping the business's industry sector (e.g., restaurant, foundry).

business_address_raw.description: Literal address of the physical operating site of the business.

partners_raw.description: The literal, unparsed parenthetical list of business owners, corporate officers, or partners.

associated_individual_ids.description: Semicolon-delimited array of unique individual IDs pointing to partner rows in individuals.csv (e.g., IND_1892_0941;IND_1892_0942).
